title: The six new repositories have not deployed: set each one's Pages source to 'Deploy from a branch: dev, / (root)' (or a deploy workflow, through security), then dev checks every site live
note: Done on 25 October, 22:24 UTC: the six had the Pages source 'GitHub Actions' and no workflow, so nothing ever built; each now has v1's deploy workflow with its own gate as the check (the editor's go in session; security to review), and all six serve: press, data, site (staged at site.), refs, updates, team. Checked live in a browser: scripts from the press, data from the API, the Ask pane, view addresses, the 404 page's redirect across sites; manifest sums match.
